title: 第19章 强大妖兽第20章 陈阳显威
content_zh:
兽潮已经持续了一个多时辰，如今的战场已经来到前阵防线。
这期间杨灵睿又斩杀了三只妖兽，山崖上灵虎灵清二人也将那二重狼妖击杀。
但很快，他们就都感受到了强大的气息。
聚气三重的妖兽！
一只长着赤色对角的牦牛冲下山，直奔杨家而来。
杨灵睿意识到不能让它靠近防线，于是一跃而起，出击迎敌，把这只牦牛妖拦在了防线二十丈之外。
但毕竟是差了一重境界，杨灵睿罡风术法再厉害，也只能与其打个平手。
罡风只能对其造成皮肉伤，不足以致命。
“退！”
杨灵睿见状果断向族兵下令，杨铁力立马组织手下后撤。
想要解决这只强大妖兽，他必须有足够的空间与其周旋。
簌——
杨灵睿调动灵力，制造出罡风将自己的身体包裹。
这是杨灵清在观察过他的罡风术法后，给他想出的法子。
缠绕周身的罡风能够提供一定的防御效果，还可以提升他的移动速度。
如此一来，他在速度上就不会弱于牦牛妖太多。
接着利用术法的远距离优势，杨灵睿便开始牵着牛鼻子走，在战场上来回穿梭。
不断消磨其气力的同时，也借它这敌我不分横冲直撞的架势阻挡兽潮。
另一边，山崖上也来了个大家伙。
一只体长十米的蟒蛇妖，同样是聚气三重境界。

但好在杨家这边有人数优势，可以两头牵制。
杨灵清和杨灵虎配合默契，也能勉强拦下这只蛇妖，不过想要击杀还是有难度的。
杨灵清握了握怀中的异石，随后又松开来。
“不行，还不是时候！”
她有些想用灵力冲击斩杀蟒蛇妖，但这道术法可是拥有聚气中期的威力，用在这蛇妖身上太不值当。
唔——
一道破空声传来。
蟒蛇妖扭动身体一个甩尾抽向杨灵虎，差了两个小境界之下，如果这一下挨结实了，他即便不死也是重伤。
但因为身陷泥沼的缘故，蛇妖甩尾的速度有所延缓。
杨灵虎也是胆子大，主动上前用肩头卸力，然后借势一个后仰，在空中翻了两圈方才落地。
“嘶...”
虽说化解了攻击，但肩头还是传来了撕裂般的痛感，他咬牙忍了下来。
随后蛇妖继续扭动身体朝他过来，只是地面的泥沼就像一个甩不走的鼻涕虫，死活粘着它。
content_en:
The beast tide has lasted for more than an hour, and the battlefield has now reached the front line of defense.
During this period, Yang Lingrui killed three more monsters, and the two men on the cliff, Linghu Lingqing, also killed the two-level wolf monster.
But soon, they all felt the powerful aura.
A monster with three levels of Qi gathering!
A yak with red diagonal horns rushed down the mountain and headed straight for Yang's house.
Yang Lingrui realized that he couldn't let it get close to the defense line, so he jumped up and attacked the enemy, blocking the yak demon twenty feet away from the defense line.
But after all, he was one level behind. No matter how powerful Yang Lingrui's Gangfeng technique was, he could only compete with him.
Gangfeng can only cause flesh wounds to it, but it is not fatal.
"Back off!"
Upon seeing this, Yang Lingrui decisively ordered the clan soldiers, and Yang Tieli immediately organized his men to retreat.
To deal with this powerful monster, he must have enough space to deal with it.
簌——
Yang Lingrui mobilized his spiritual power and created a strong wind to wrap around his body.
This was the method Yang Lingqing came up with for him after observing his Gang Feng technique.
The strong wind surrounding him can provide a certain defensive effect and can also increase his movement speed.
In this way, he will not be much weaker than the yak demon in terms of speed.
Then taking advantage of the long-distance advantage of the magic, Yang Lingrui began to lead the bull by the nose, shuttling back and forth on the battlefield.
While constantly consuming its strength, it also used its attitude of charging rampantly without distinguishing between friend and foe to block the tide of beasts.
On the other side, a big guy also came on the cliff.
A python demon with a body length of ten meters is also in the third level of Qi gathering.
But fortunately, the Yang family has a numerical advantage and can contain them from both ends.
Yang Lingqing and Yang Linghu cooperated tacitly and were able to barely stop the snake demon, but it was still difficult to kill it.
Yang Lingqing held the strange stone in his arms, and then let go.
"No, it's not the time yet!"
She wanted to use spiritual power to attack the python demon, but this technique had the power of the middle stage of Qi gathering, so it was not worth using on this snake demon.
Uh--
A sound broke through the air.
The python demon twisted its body and flicked its tail towards Yang Linghu, missing Yang Linghu by two small realms. If the blow was strong, he would be seriously injured even if he did not die.
However, because it was trapped in the quagmire, the speed of the snake demon's tail flick was slowed down.
Yang Linghu was also brave. He took the initiative to step forward and use his shoulders to relieve the pressure. Then he used the momentum to lean back and flipped twice in the air before landing.
"Hiss..."
Although he neutralized the attack, he still felt a tearing pain in his shoulder, and he gritted his teeth and endured it.
Then the snake demon continued to twist its body towards him, but the swamp on the ground was like a slug that couldn't be shaken away, clinging to it life and death.
